description: The auto-filter dropdown shown for a single header column. Offers ascending/descending sort, a search box over the distinct values, a checkbox list (with select-all), an entry point to the custom (text/number/date) filter dialog, and OK/Cancel. All text is localized.

parameters.name: Sheet
parameters.description: The sheet the filter applies to.

parameters.name: ColumnIndex
parameters.description: The zero-based column index this dropdown filters.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture used to format and compare values.

parameters.name: OnApply
parameters.description: Raised when the user applies a value filter (null clears this column's filter).

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dropdown is dismissed.

parameters.name: OnOpenCustomFilter
parameters.description: Raised when the user opens the custom text/number/date filter dialog.

parameters.name: OnSortAscending
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests an ascending sort by this column.

parameters.name: OnSortDescending
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a descending sort by this column.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: The left position (px) of the dropdown.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: The top position (px) of the dropdown.
